discrepancies.note: Manual states 17 standard/service and 36 express. Supplied executable initializes 21/42 (390FC/39904). Keep executable values; rendered manual page 47 confirms this is not an OCR error.

Manual describes four/seven sets; native reach validators 34B12/34A52 allow spans of three/six floor transitions (four/seven floor levels). Treat executable comparisons as authority and retain the counting distinction in tests.
Manual says random day and 13:00 explosion; supplied binary uses recovered date moduli and 15:00 deadline. Implementation must follow the binary event dispatcher.
Manual explicitly says its formulas/numbers are illustrative, not precise release formulas. Use PART resources and IDA callers for numeric rules; keep manual qualitative lifecycle requirements.

Manual describes radial noise and underground residences for treasure; supplied native caller scans horizontal cell distances and tests basement width/rating. Do not overwrite recovered checks with prose simplifications.
Manual illustrations show platform-specific window conventions. Target remains the supplied Win16 executable and original resources; browser/OS file dialogs are not exact Windows shells.
